title: Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2611.30742v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are often ranked by an LLM judge whose error rates are measured once and reused for every agent. The corrected success rates can then be biased when the judge's errors depend on the trajectory and agents differ in the trajectories they produce for successes or failures. We derive the exact asymptotic bias and give a chain of checks from identification to simultaneous ranks. On a four-agent semi-synthetic benchmark, a scalar correction with oracle calibration has maximum bias 0.245 and mean pointwise coverage 0.016, and never recovers the full ranking (0/250 replications). Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) with a uniform or a design-aware random audit keeps the maximum bias below 0.003, with mean pointwise coverage of 0.939 and 0.950. translated_title: 面向可迁移安全的LLM智能体评估：轨迹依赖的裁判误差与随时有效的审计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常由一个LLM裁判进行排名，而该裁判的错误率仅被测量一次，随后被重复用于所有智能体。当裁判的错误依赖于轨迹、且不同智能体在成功或失败时产生的轨迹各不相同时，校正后的成功率便可能产生偏差。我们推导出了精确的渐近偏差，并给出了从可识别性到同时排名检验的一系列检验链条。在一个四智能体半合成基准上，采用预言机校准的标量校正最大偏差为0.245，平均逐点覆盖率仅为0.016，且在250次重复实验中从未恢复出完整排名（0/250）。而采用均匀审计或设计感知随机审计的增广逆概率加权（AIPW）方法可将最大偏差保持在0.003以下，平均逐点覆盖率分别达到0.939和0.950。在一个包含48个单元格的压力测试中，随着校准标注量从600增长到4800，有效目标支持度仅从0.209上升至0.805，而经过审计的AIPW保持平均……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 当LLM裁判的误差随智能体产生的轨迹而变化时，仅凭一次性校准的标量校正会产生高达0.245的严重偏差且几乎无法恢复真实排名，而论文提出的结合随机审计的增广逆概率加权（AIPW）方法可将最大偏差控制在0.003以下并达到约94%–95%的覆盖率。
en_tdlr: When LLM-judge errors depend on agent trajectories, one-shot scalar correction is severely biased (max bias 0.245) and fails to recover rankings, whereas the proposed AIPW with random auditing keeps bias below 0.003 with roughly 94–95% pointwise coverage.
